name: Real footage: lab pendulum (Jefferson Lab)
description: Public footage from Jefferson Lab's Frostbite Theater video "Swinging Pendulums (Different Angles)" (YouTube), cropped, with the video's on-screen labels blacked out. A white washer on a thread hangs from the clamp of a lab stand. Nothing of known size is in view, so use the horizontal silver bar at the top of the stand as a fixed landmark (concept "silver bar", known_size_m 0): angles and periods only. This clip swings about 7 degrees; the largest swing available in the same footage is about 25 degrees.

proposal.feasibility_note: Recommend 25° because it is the feasible setting with the largest physical effect (1% difference in the predicted observable) among settings that separate the models by ≥10σ. Expected separation 151.0σ RMS (max 341σ) after the 0.5 s conditioning window. Searched only up to 25°, the most this setup allows.
proposal.filming_instructions: Release the same pendulum from 25° (string taut, bob at rest), keep the camera and the reference object exactly where they were, and record at least 6 full swings.
